specification.title: Typed Scene Entity Records
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Document, EntityID, FeatureID, layers, blocks/instances, metadata đá và tham chiếu đối tượng.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tạo UI quản lý Layers tại đây.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Typed Scene Entity Records” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

plugin_sdk_v1_attributes.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_attributes.scope: Typed scene entity records: SDK v1 returns typed object records with geometry kind, layer, placement, generation and geometry/attributes revisions, and serves a filtered, ordered, paged query (layer, exact geometry kind, label substring, selection only, hidden inclusion) with a total match count.
limitations: Partial scope only: this entry does not close the L3.
One source write per object per command: transform, attributes and rename cannot be combined.
Layer CRUD/current/assignment, groups, blocks/instances and change notification remain open.

plugin_sdk_v1_placement.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_placement.scope: set_object_placement writes one object's affine placement matrix through Mutation::Placement after Transform::validate (finite, last row [0,0,0,1], invertible linear part). One source write per object per command; an object created in the same command carries its insert placement instead; Undo restores the previous matrix.
limitations: Nested object/instance transforms and gumball interaction remain open.
A created-in-command object cannot be placed afterwards.

plugin_sdk_v1_placement_read.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_placement_read.scope: object_placement returns the staged placement when set, else the base entity matrix; object-local, no parent composition.

sdk_export_plan.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
